title: Results trickling in after Israel's election shine a light on a complex political system
summary:
JERUSALEM (AP) — Israel was counting votes Wednesday in pivotal elections where no clear winner emerged in exit polls — a scenario that is shining a light on the country's complex political system.
Exit polls suggested Netanyahu's opponents had secured enough seats to form a government.
Israelis vote for parties and not candidates, and no single party has ever won an outright 61-seat majority in the Knesset, meaning political leaders must forge coalitions to govern.
